candidate.definition_en: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
candidate.explanation_ar: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.

senses.definition_en: A highly intelligent sea mammal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
senses.definition_ar: حيوان ثديي بحري ذكي جداً، يشبه السمكة الكبيرة وله خطم يشبه المنقار.
examples: I saw a dolphin in the sea.
A friendly dolphin leaped high out of the water.
